stories.title: House Democrat targets Trump family and top officials in early steps toward promised investigations
stories.summary: Letters sent to Trump’s administration and family cover a wide range of potential investigations, including alleged financial conflicts involving his family, misconduct at DHS and the handling of files related to Jeffrey Epstein.

stories.title: Bodies of mother and daughter recovered from vehicle in Southeast Alaska river, troopers say
stories.summary: Craig residents Kelly Jenkins, 34, and Kayleigh Favor, 13, had been missing since last week when their vehicle plunged into the Thorne River.

stories.title: Coalition-aligned candidates flip 4 Alaska House seats, shrinking GOP minority
stories.summary: Democrats and independents led Republicans in districts covering parts of Anchorage, Fairbanks and the Kenai Peninsula.

stories.title: Begich wins second term as Alaska’s lone U.S. House member
stories.summary: Nick Begich was the only Republican to win a statewide race in Alaska this year.

stories.title: Kreiss-Tomkins begins building administration with key appointments
stories.summary: Ira Slomski-Pritz will serve as the incoming Alaska governor’s chief of staff.

stories.title: Fairbanks-area high school hockey teams suspended amid sexual assault, kidnapping investigation
stories.summary: The Wasilla Police Department is investigating conduct involving the two teams during a Mat-Su tournament earlier this month.

stories.title: Alaska sports notebook: UAA women’s basketball takes on DI powerhouse in Great Alaska Shootout, Bartlett hockey picks up win
stories.summary: The latest news and notes from across the sports landscape in the 49th state.

stories.title: Peltola calls for bipartisanship after winning U.S. Senate race: ‘Alaska has so much to teach the rest of the nation’
stories.summary: Peltola flipped the seat out of Republican control and became the first Democrat to represent Alaska in the U.S. Senate since 2015.

stories.title: Legislators question Dunleavy administration’s move to grant land rights to gas line developers
stories.summary: The Dunleavy administration is looking to finalize a right-of-way lease for the developers of an 800-mile gas pipeline.

stories.title: GOP-led investigations still underway after Peltola wins Alaska’s US Senate race
stories.summary: A spokesperson with the Alaska Department of Public Safety said Wednesday that the state investigation initiated at the direction of outgoing Republican Gov. Mike Dunleavy is still underway.

stories.title: Some Alaska legislative races could go to recount after ranked choice tabulation
stories.summary: Wednesday’s final ballot count cemented the win of Rep. Nick Begich for the U.S. House seat, as well as three Republican challengers in the Mat-Su who defeated incumbent state lawmakers.

stories.title: Ex-Red Dog worker files proposed class-action lawsuit seeking unpaid wages for time gearing up, traveling
stories.summary: The lawsuit asserted that Teck Alaska should have paid for time spent getting in and out of safety gear, and the more than three hours it takes for employees to travel round-trip from Anchorage for multiweek shifts.
